note: The country list is fixed HERE, before a single record of test #3 was collected, so that it cannot be tuned to a result. Committed in its own commit, ahead of the collection commit, so the ordering is provable from git history rather than asserted.

selectionRule.rule: Every country previously queried by any CIPHER collection, PLUS every additional country measured to hold at least one LEI-bearing business entity in the 2026-09-08 availability probe.
selectionRule.chosenBy: Measured data availability and breadth only.
explicitlyNotChosenBy: any observed behaviour of the v2 or v3 model
any error class identified in P6.25 or P6.26
selectionRule.whyThisMatters: P6.26's v3 corpus was collected against countries picked for high foreign incorporation - chosen in response to a measured model failure. That is legitimate for a TRAINING corpus and disqualifying for a TEST one. Test #3 must not be able to flatter or punish either model through its country mix, so the country mix is not a free parameter.

limitPolicy.effect: limit == MAX_LIMIT for every country, so there is no within-country selection at all: the collection takes everything the publisher returns for the constant query. The only declared choice is the country list above.

leakageControl.subjectExclusion: Applied at corpus-build time against ALL FIVE prior datasets, in every partition.
leakageControl.note: Country re-use is expected and harmless: the previously-collected runs were LIMIT-bound (GB returned 185 distinct items against 851 available; DE holds 2,718), so re-sweeping at MAX_LIMIT reaches the unseen tail. Freshness is enforced on the SUBJECT, which is what L1-L13 measure, never on the country.
